blocks.content: Source of irrigation and hydroelectric power.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Rivers deposit fertile alluvial soils that significantly boost agricultural productivity.
They serve as indispensable sources of irrigation and renewable hydroelectric power.
Rivers provide natural inland transport routes for movement and trade.
They play a fundamental role in sustaining diverse aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems.

blocks.content: • Source of irrigation and hydroelectric power.

items: Exam questions frequently ask about the dual economic role of rivers as sources of irrigation and hydroelectric power generation.
Remember that rivers are primary agents in forming fertile alluvial soil deposits crucial for river basin agriculture.
